topic: Negotiating a raise vs never asking (Jonas vs Marnie)

scenes.narration: One five minute conversation earned her seventy thousand dollars over a career. Today's training session begins now!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault in a gym pointing at a rising salary chart, comic burst banner reads SEVENTY THOUSAND, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Jonas and Marnie start the same job at fifty thousand each.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man jonas and woman marnie at matching desks with offer letters stamped FIFTY THOUSAND, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Both do strong work and earn solid yearly reviews.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, both jonas and marnie holding review sheets stamped GREAT WORK, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Jonas waits silently and hopes managers notice his effort.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, jonas at a desk staying quiet, a thought bubble reading MAYBE THEYLL NOTICE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: He never once asks, so his pay only creeps slowly.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, jonas watching a tiny salary bar barely inch upward, comic banner reads NEVER ASKED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Marnie researches her market value and books a meeting.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, marnie at a laptop showing MARKET RATE charts, a calendar marked MEETING, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She lists her wins and calmly asks for a raise.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, marnie confidently presenting a list labeled MY WINS to a manager, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Her manager agrees and bumps her by eight thousand.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, marnie shaking hands as a salary number jumps up stamped PLUS EIGHT THOUSAND, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Ten years later Jonas earns barely above where he started.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, jonas at his desk with a salary bar still near FIFTY, a calendar reading TEN YEARS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Marnie negotiated every few years and now earns far more.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, marnie beside a tall rising salary staircase chart, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Those raises compound, adding seventy thousand across her career.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, marnie holding a check labeled SEVENTY THOUSAND with stacking coins behind her, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Research your value, list your wins, and ask. Drop and give me twenty bucks!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault blowing a whistle, holding a clipboard reading ASK FOR THE RAISE, comic burst banner reads TWENTY BUCKS, kids comic book illustration
